# CLA signatures — version 1

One file per contributor, named after the contributor's GitHub login in lowercase
(`.github/cla/v1/<login>.md`). Each file is that contributor's signature on
[`CLA.md`](../../../CLA.md) version 1: the commit that adds it, in the contributor's own pull
request, is the act of signing.

Do not edit or remove someone else's signature. If the agreement is revised, the new text gets a
`v2/` directory beside this one and contributors sign again there — signatures are never carried
forward to terms the signer did not read.

`.github/workflows/cla.yml` checks that a pull request author has a file here. Everyone signs,
members of the iyulab organization included; only bots are exempt and have no file.
